rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality blastocyst and correctly notes favorable ICM/TE and thinned zona, but it hedges between stages and introduces uncertain features (possible hatching/opening, collapse/artifact) not clearly supported.

Integrates age, tubal factor, ovarian reserve, BMI, endometrium, sperm parameters, and first-cycle status well, though interaction between obesity and implantation/live birth could be more precisely framed.
Overall structure is logical, but there are internal inconsistencies in staging/probability discussion and some hedging between 3AA, AA-AB, and different implantation ranges.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice, especially favoring single embryo transfer in a young patient with a good blastocyst; minor deviations include speculative comments about double embryo transfer and somewhat loose use of morphology-based probability estimates.
Provides practical next steps for transfer, luteal support review, uterine reassessment, and future-cycle considerations, though some advice remains generic rather than tightly protocol-specific.
